title: The Social Default
coreMove: Separate what the group rewards from what the facts support before agreeing.
sourcePressure: Social pressure rewards conformity before truth. This chapter should focus on belonging pressure, group norms, borrowed judgment, and the pause needed before a room's momentum decides for you.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Reducing social default to teenage peer pressure or treating all group influence as bad.

sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: A room can reward agreement so quickly that truth starts to feel impolite.
